description: This PHP file handles operations related to RSS feed management in the vtiger CRM, including updating the 'starred' status of RSS entries and setting new RSS URLs.

classes.name: vtigerRSS
classes.description: A class responsible for handling RSS feed operations such as setting RSS URLs and saving RSS data.

methods.name: setRSSUrl
methods.description: Sets the RSS URL in an instance of vtigerRSS, validating the URL.

methods.name: saveRSSUrl
methods.description: Saves the RSS URL to the database or storage with an optional starred status.
